$comment: Checked-in expected bundle sizes, the way Angular's repo keeps goldens/size-tracking/*.json.
`gzip` is the gzipped byte count of the entry bundled in --external mode (@ethlete code only,
no Angular runtime constant). Regenerate with `nx run treeshake:bundle-goldens:update` and commit
the diff as a deliberate, reviewable change - that is the whole point of the file.
The floors are what an app pays for importing one tiny symbol; the rest is one real entry per
big domain, so a regression can be attributed instead of just noticed.
